title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council’s recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
part_text: 2. Welcomes the Commission’s proposal for an updated Council recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments; considers the rise in the use of HTPs, e-cigarettes and other aerosol-emitting products in public, outdoor and indoor spaces, including in the hotel and catering sector, to be a risk to public health;
